design: Cross-production piano versus guitar, frozen lab2 frontend, price 0.30, prior 22 works and all 19 upload accounts ineligible.
separate_old_reference: Prior gallery and original free/paid front-end weights are fixed independently; prior 22 files cannot appear in new cohorts.
source_rule: Process each class priority list in fixed order. Retain first 11 technically eligible independent works. Assign retained works in order to the published partition slots. If fewer than 11 survive, truncate to the available slots and report reduced scope. Identical publisher checksums, named creators/performers/shooting production or account used by the old roster or a new cohort are ineligible. No model, scores or signal energy can qualify a source. All same-master alternate uploads ineligible.
source_label: Publisher attribution of physically recorded piano or guitar as the primary instrument. This includes filmed performance demonstrations, electric effects and actual steel guitar. Excludes sampled toy and purely synthetic/electronic score demos, narration-only lessons, and derivative copies of previous works. Real musicians, studio or live performance and source footage; genre, backing vocals and instruments uncontrolled.
time_rule: Four independently placed 2.88s windows per production. Divide central 90% of container duration into 4 equal quarters. First/last canonical anchors are 5%,95%-2.88s, interior anchors evenly spaced between them. Each window must fit completely in its quarter, with 0.1s inner-edge guards. Try the clipped anchor, then candidate starts on 0.10s grid in ascending distance to the candidate's canonical anchor (tie = earlier). First valid window accepted. Require all four quarters to succeed. Eligibility depends only on clock/sample coverage/stream presence. Full original audio must span the window. No decoded-frame time gap/overlap greater than one original PCM packet time-base tick. Reject if raw seeked decoded PCM has fewer than the required samples, any covered block has timestamp more than 1 native audio sample ahead of buffer clock, or source has no causal presented video frame. No manufactured silence or frame substitutions.
freeze: Pin old source manifest, every selected source's canonical URL, Commons page and file versions, byte length, publisher SHA1, local SHA256, partition and 4 exact starts before any score. No paid semantic TEST extraction, training or confirmation before selection seal. Original media are never redistributed.
